April 12, 1999  
Valle Department  
Municipality of Cali  

A minor died from third-degree burns covering his entire body, which occurred at the Valle de Lili Rehabilitation Center. The minor had six previous entries into the institution and had attempted to avoid his transfer on this occasion by lying about his age during his capture, hoping to be sent to the Villahermosa prison. The victim had warned his mother that his life was in danger at the facility. Both the police authorities and the rehabilitation center's management stated that the young man’s death was a suicide.  

The victim's family publicly accused the custodians of the minor and reported that: "I saw him very badly, so I decided to record his voice. He said he put the mattress on the bars to cover himself and sat close to it when he saw flames coming over him. While he was burning, no one helped him. After a long time, someone from the center helped him." This is not the first case of minors being brutally murdered at this institution, with National Police officers involved in previous incidents.
